instruction: Write an XDP program that rewrites the IPv4 TOS/DSCP field to value 20 (0x14), recalculates the IPv4 checksum, and passes the packet with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Recalculate or incrementally update the IPv4 header checksum
Check boundaries on Ethernet and IPv4 headers

tests.name: test_remark_pass
tests.description: IPv4 packet should have TOS updated to 20 and pass

tests.name: test_tcp_remark_pass
tests.description: IPv4 TCP packet should have TOS updated to 20 and pass

tests.name: test_truncated_pass
tests.description: Truncated Ethernet frame header should pass with XDP_PASS
